researchQuestion: When did a matched filing value or its admissible evidence state become different from the state available to an earlier research decision?

eventDefinition.issuerComparativeValueDifference: A matched fact has a different numerical value in a later issuer comparative filing. This label does not by itself assert error or restatement.
eventDefinition.researchReleaseSourceUpgrade: A derived value is unchanged while the filing status, evidence object, primary-matrix eligibility or comparability tier changes between frozen research releases.
eventDefinition.noEventBoundary: No event means no event was detected in the explicitly compared artifacts. It does not mean the issuer has never revised a filing value.

pointInTimePolicy.knowledgeClock: SEC acceptance timestamp for issuer facts; frozen release cutoff for research-release state.
pointInTimePolicy.selectionRule: At a decision time, use only the latest eligible state available on or before that time.
pointInTimePolicy.noSilentOverwrite: Later states and later research releases never replace an earlier frozen object.
pointInTimePolicy.missingDataRule: Missing or ineligible observations remain unavailable and are never converted to zero.

limitations: Version 1 is an event corpus over two explicitly defined comparisons, not a complete history of every filing by every observed issuer.
A comparative value difference is not automatically an error, accounting correction or issuer-identified restatement.
Five observed issuers have no event in the compared cross-section releases; this is not evidence that they have never revised a filing value.
The corpus tests data lineage and availability. It does not estimate alpha, information coefficient, portfolio return, Sharpe ratio or drawdown.
Company names and ticker symbols identify source filers only. AhaSignals is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the issuers or the SEC.
Research and education only; not investment, trading, legal, accounting or tax advice.
